name: Dumbbell bench press
steps: Sit on the end of the flat bench with a dumbbell on each thigh, then lie back and bring them to your chest.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your chest, elbows at about 45° from your body.
Press back up, bringing the dumbbells slightly together at the top.
form: Feet flat on the floor, shoulder blades pulled back and down.
Keep your wrists straight above your elbows.
mistakes: Bouncing the weights off your chest.

name: Dumbbell floor press
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly, then press back up.
form: Elbows at about 45° from your body.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
mistakes: Letting the elbows crash into the floor.

name: Dumbbell fly
steps: Lie on the bench with the dumbbells pressed up over your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in the elbows, open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch across your chest.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back up along the same arc.
form: Keep the elbow bend fixed through the whole movement.
Move slowly, especially on the way down.
mistakes: Going too heavy and turning it into a press.
Dropping the arms below the bench.

name: Push-up
steps: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the floor, elbows at about 45°.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight.
form: Squeeze your glutes and brace your core so your hips don't sag.
Look slightly ahead of your hands.

name: Incline push-up
steps: Place your hands on the edge of the bench, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body is a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench edge, then push back up.
form: Keep the body straight like a plank.
Make sure the bench is stable and won't slide.

name: Decline push-up
steps: Put your feet on the bench and your hands on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the floor.
Push back up to straight arms.
form: Keep your hips in line with your body.
Brace your core the whole time.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag towards the floor.

name: Knee push-up
steps: Kneel with your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest towards the floor and push back up.
form: Hips in line, not pushed back.
mistakes: Bending at the hips instead of lowering the chest.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Stand (or sit on the bench) with the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press them straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.
form: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes; don't lean back.
Keep the dumbbells over your shoulders.

name: Lateral raise
steps: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
With a slight bend in the elbows, raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
form: Lead with the elbows, not the hands.
Use light weights; control matters more than load.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weights.

name: Front raise
steps: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise them straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
form: Keep the torso still.
Slight bend in the elbows.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the weights up.

name: Reverse fly
steps: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below your shoulders.
With soft elbows, raise the arms out to the sides.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.
form: Keep the back flat and the neck neutral.
Light weights.

name: Dumbbell bent-over row
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is about 45°.
Pull the weights towards your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.
form: Flat back, neck in line with your spine.
Knees slightly bent; no jerking.

name: Single-arm row
steps: Put one knee and the same hand on the bench, back flat.
Hold the dumbbell in the other hand, arm straight down.
Pull it up towards your hip, elbow close to your side.
Lower slowly and repeat; then switch sides.
form: Keep the hips and shoulders level.
Think of pulling with the elbow.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight.

name: Renegade row
steps: Start in a push-up position holding the dumbbells on the floor.
Row one dumbbell to your hip while balancing on the other.
Put it down and row the other side.
form: Feet wide for balance.
Keep the hips square to the floor.
mistakes: Rotating the hips as you row.

name: Dumbbell pullover
steps: Lie on the bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
With slightly bent elbows, lower it back behind your head.
Stop at a comfortable stretch, then pull it back over your chest.
form: Keep the lower back on the bench.
Move slowly.
mistakes: Bending the elbows more and more (turning it into a triceps exercise).

name: Superman hold
steps: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor.
Hold, breathing calmly.
form: Look at the floor to keep the neck neutral.
Lift only a few centimetres.

name: Biceps curl
steps: Stand with the dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl them up towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly all the way down.
form: Elbows stay at your sides.
No swinging.
mistakes: Using the back to swing the weights.

name: Hammer curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides with palms facing your body.
Curl them up keeping the palms facing in.
Lower slowly.
form: Elbows fixed at your sides.

name: Overhead triceps extension
steps: Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Straighten the arms to lift it back up.
form: Elbows point forward and stay close.
Brace your core; don't arch.

name: Triceps kickback
steps: Support yourself with one knee and hand on the bench, back flat.
Hold the dumbbell with the upper arm along your side, elbow bent.
Straighten the arm backwards, then bend it again.
form: Only the forearm moves.

name: Bench dip
steps: Sit on the edge of the bench, hands next to your hips, fingers forward.
Slide your hips off the bench, feet on the floor.
Lower by bending your elbows to about 90°, then push back up.
form: Keep your back close to the bench.
Shoulders down, away from your ears.
mistakes: Going too deep and straining the shoulders.

name: Goblet squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest, feet a bit wider than your hips.
Sit down between your heels, knees following your toes.
Go as low as you can with a flat back, then stand up.
form: Chest up, weight on the whole foot.
Knees track over the toes.

name: Bodyweight squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms in front.
Sit back and down as if onto a chair.
Stand up by pushing through the whole foot.
form: Chest up, back flat.
Knees follow the toes.
easier: Squat to the bench (sit and stand)

name: Dumbbell lunge
steps: Stand holding the dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are at about 90°.
Push through the front heel to step back; alternate legs.
form: Upper body upright.
Front knee over the ankle, not caving in.
mistakes: Steps too short, knee far past the toes.

name: Reverse lunge
steps: Stand tall, hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and lower the back knee towards the floor.
Push through the front foot to return; alternate.
form: Torso upright.
Front heel stays down.

name: Bulgarian split squat
steps: Stand a big step in front of the bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Holding the dumbbells, lower until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to stand; finish all reps, then switch legs.
form: Most of the weight on the front leg.
Torso slightly forward is fine; back flat.
mistakes: Standing too close to the bench.

name: Step-up
steps: Stand facing the bench with the dumbbells at your sides.
Put one whole foot on the bench and push through it to stand up on the bench.
Step down with control; do all reps, then switch legs.
form: Drive with the top leg, not by bouncing off the bottom one.
Make sure the bench is stable.
mistakes: Pushing off with the back foot.

name: Romanian deadlift (DB)
steps: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs, knees soft.
Stop at a stretch in the hamstrings (around mid-shin), then drive the hips forward to stand.
form: Flat back the whole time.
The movement is at the hips, not the knees.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower.

name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near your hips.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower.
form: Ribs down; don't arch the lower back.
mistakes: Pushing with the lower back instead of the glutes.
harder: Dumbbell on the hips or single-leg

name: Hip thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of the bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Feet flat, knees bent.
Drive your hips up until your thighs and body are level; squeeze, then lower.
form: Chin slightly tucked, ribs down.
Shins vertical at the top.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.

name: Calf raise
steps: Stand holding the dumbbells at your sides.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower slowly.
form: Pause at the top.

name: Plank
steps: Rest on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
Make a straight line from head to heels.
Hold, breathing steadily.
form: Squeeze glutes, brace the stomach.
Don't hold your breath.

name: Side plank
steps: Lie on your side resting on one forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body is a straight line.
Hold; then switch sides.
form: Hips stacked, not rolling forward.

name: Dead bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90° over your hips.
Slowly lower one arm and the opposite leg towards the floor.
Return and switch sides.
form: Keep the lower back pressed into the floor.

name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, hands lightly at your temples.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly.
form: Don't pull on your neck.
harder: Hold a dumbbell on the chest

name: Russian twist
steps: Sit with knees bent, lean back a little, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side, then to the other.
form: Turn from the ribs, not just the arms.
Back straight.

name: Hollow hold
steps: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift shoulders and legs off the floor, pressing the lower back down.
Hold.
form: Lower back stays on the floor.
harder: Lower the legs closer to the floor

name: Mountain climbers
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee towards your chest, then switch legs quickly.
form: Hips level, shoulders over the hands.

name: Jumping jacks
steps: Stand with feet together, arms at your sides.
Jump the feet out while raising the arms overhead.
Jump back to the start; keep a steady rhythm.
form: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: High knees
steps: Run on the spot, bringing your knees up to hip height.
Pump your arms.
form: Stay on the balls of your feet, stand tall.

name: Burpee
steps: From standing, squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back to a plank.
Jump or step them back in, then stand up and jump.
form: Keep the plank straight.

name: Arm circles
steps: Stand with arms out to the sides.
Make small circles, growing bigger; switch direction halfway.
form: Relaxed shoulders.

name: Hip circles
steps: Stand with hands on your hips.
Make big slow circles with your hips; switch direction halfway.
form: Keep the movement smooth.

name: Cat-cow
steps: On hands and knees, round your back up towards the ceiling.
Then let the stomach drop and lift your chest and tailbone.
Move slowly with your breath.
form: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

name: Farmer's hold
steps: Pick up heavy dumbbells and stand tall (or walk slowly around the room).
Hold for the time.
form: Shoulders back and down, core braced.
harder: Heavier, or one side at a time

name: Dumbbell thruster
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squat down.
Stand up powerfully and press the dumbbells overhead in one movement.
Lower them to your shoulders as you go into the next squat.
form: Chest up in the squat.
Use the legs to drive the press.

name: Wall sit
steps: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your knees are at about 90°.
Hold.
form: Knees over the ankles, back flat on the wall.
harder: Hold a dumbbell on your thighs
